topic: Agentic EEG preprocessing pipeline with FOOOF-based signal quality optimization
topic_original: 建造一個 Agentic EEG pre-processing pipeline：(1) 傳統 greedy search 跑遍所有 preprocessing 組合建立 ground truth；(2) 用 FOOOF 週期性(signal)與非週期性(noise)計算 SNR 衡量好壞，捨棄 accuracy；(3) 有 ground truth 後讓 agent 學習挑選 preprocessing 參數。LLM-agent 路線、公開資料集。

pico.population: EEG recordings from public datasets (resting-state and task-based); the study objects are signals and pipeline configurations rather than patients
pico.intervention: LLM-agent-driven adaptive selection of preprocessing parameters (filtering, ICA, artifact rejection, re-referencing) guided by intermediate signal features
pico.comparison: Fixed/standard pipelines (PREP, HAPPE, Autoreject), exhaustive greedy search as ground-truth oracle, and random/default parameter selection
pico.outcome: Signal quality via FOOOF aperiodic(1/f)-periodic decomposition as SNR proxy; agreement with greedy-search ground truth; compute cost
pico.setting: Offline batch preprocessing, reproducible research pipelines

queries.query: automated EEG preprocessing pipeline artifact removal parameter optimization
queries.rationale: Direct hit on automated EEG preprocessing and parameter optimization literature (PREP, HAPPE, Autoreject)

queries.rationale: Catches papers using alternative terminology (cleaning, QC, standardization) for the same preprocessing problem

queries.query: FOOOF aperiodic periodic spectral parameterization 1/f EEG signal quality SNR
queries.rationale: FOOOF/specparam separation of periodic and aperiodic components and its use as a signal-quality / SNR metric
